root_cause: Legacy profileOverviewMetrics used hardcoded 24 employee and €52/hour defaults plus maturity level 2 whenever a customer's fields were missing, then rendered their derived monetary and efficiency metrics in live customer dashboard/profile views. The figures looked customer-specific but were calculated from silent sample assumptions.
prevention_rule: All 13 maturity dimensions and customer employee headcount and hourly cost must be explicitly recorded before any customer profile maturity/capacity/monetary KPI is calculated. Unknown must be null/em dash, never zero or a legacy benchmark. Even with complete inputs output is MODEL_ESTIMATE_FROM_ENTERED_INPUTS (46-week/legacy benchmark assumptions), not observed cash savings; never silently treat a model estimate as realized outcome.
